title: TopologySemanticContextResolveRequest
description: Resolve compact, catalog-backed semantic context for an active topology artifact so agent-core can ground follow-up selectors without receiving graph internals.

artifact.description: Validated topology base binding that identifies the active view, scope, params, limits, and time mode for either an artifact or a workbench session.

intent.description: Optional high-recall semantic hints from agent-core, such as candidate catalog ids for live topology overlay signals.

limits.description: Optional context response shaping limits. topology-service applies safe defaults when omitted.
